list.title: Journal
list.description: {count} events match. The journal ends at position {head}.
list.error: The journal could not be loaded.

file.title: Journal file
file.description: The journal is the record of everything that happened in your channel. Save a copy, or load one you saved before. Loading adds only what is missing.
file.imported: Read {total} lines. {imported} new, {duplicate} already there, {upcast} upgraded to the current format.

readModels.title: Pages built from the journal
readModels.description: Viewer profiles, analytics and the event log are built from the journal. Run these after an import so the new events show up.
readModels.replayHelp: Runs the imported events through the bot again, so triggers and replies fire for them.
readModels.rebuildHelp: Clears the pages built from the journal and builds them again from the first event.
readModels.confirmTitle: Rebuild the pages built from the journal?
readModels.confirmDescription: The journal itself stays as it is. Only the pages built from it are cleared and filled again.
readModels.confirmEffect: Viewer profiles and analytics show partial numbers until the rebuild ends.

legacy.title: History from the old bot
legacy.description: Copies the channel history of the old NoMercy bot into the journal. Running it again adds nothing twice.
legacy.imported: Read {total} rows. {imported} imported, {duplicate} already there, {unmapped} not recognized. The journal grew from {before} to {after}.
